study type: Cohort study (data collected cross-sectionally at delivery)
exposure: metabolic profiles from neonatal heel prick samples
metabolic profiles from umbilical cord blood samples
cohort: The study included 1278 neonates from North India for whom paired neonatal heel prick and umbilical cord blood dried blood spot samples were collected at delivery.
finding: Models using biochemical analytes and clinical variables from neonatal heel prick and umbilical cord blood data sets demonstrated high accuracy in predicting gestational age (RMSE of 1.14 and 1.26 respectively) and identifying preterm birth (AUC of 0.89 for both) at delivery.
birth_weight: Included as a predictor variable; no specific range for the study cohort was mentioned.
gest_age: All gestational ages, as the study aimed to develop models for gestational age estimation and preterm birth classification.
